result.summary: The UI displays two minor visual issues related to content truncation and inconsistent graphical assets.

issues.description: The restaurant title 'Trattoria Piccol...' is cut off without proper ellipsis or spacing in the horizontal list.
issues.suggestion: Adjust card width or implement character limits with ellipsis to handle longer names gracefully.

issues.description: Visual style for food items is inconsistent, mixing blurred photo-like renders with flat vector illustrations.
issues.suggestion: Standardize imagery by using high-quality photography across all restaurant listings for a professional look.
